main_text.head: Augmentum temporale.
main_text.p: Horsticum 4 in Atticé reduplicatis temporaliter augetur, ut ἀκηκόα, ἠκηκόην. (ab ἀκούω tamen, ἠκούην, veneram) Item ἤδην Atticé pro εἰδὴν noram, ab εἴδω video, novi.
Aliquando etiam in medio fit augmentum istud: ut ἑολπα, ἐώλπην, sperävi, eram: ἑόρτα, ἐώρτην, feci, eram: pro ἠόλπην, ἠόρτην. sic ἔοικα, ἐώκην, similis sum, similis eram: item videor, videbar.

page.notes: Greek transcribed from a small, faded scan; several accents and breathings are uncertain and may be misread. The heading "Augmentum temporale" is italic in the original. "Horisticum" may read "Historicum" or "Horisticum"; treat with caution.
